item.title: Word of the Day: Thwarted
item.description: Phonetic: /thwart/ Part of Speech: Verb Definition Prevent (someone) from accomplishing something.“he never did anything to thwart his father” Thwarted describes something that didn’t work out, like your thwarted plan to relax at home — a friend just called to ask you to help find her runaway dog.
